text: . 14 [ &~ <) 4<|, | (8D G (& O @ & The algorithm is shown below, where z is initialized as the root of the tree. INTERVAL-SEARCH(x,1) While z # NIL and i does not overlap with z.interval if z.left # NIL and z.left.maz > i.low x = x.left else x = x.right return x Runtime The algorithm above searches from the root to a leaf in the worst case. Therefore the runtime is O(h), and if the tree is a red-black or AVL tree, then the runtime is O(logn).
